data.title: risk-high: Asterism rebaseline protocol v2 amendment
data.description: Refute merge-readiness at exact a435029. Verify v1 was invalidated before any build/row; A/B bind exact merged occupancy-metrics commit 1d8a6e0d/tree 48aa4e3b; canonical identity is v2; all workloads, ordering, statistics, thresholds, correctness gates, and outcomes remain unchanged; old tooling/prepared artifacts are invalid; document SHA-256 is f0d46f7f21abefac1f5496f58e39afea46e49d4affc999b73a004ade124d9827.

data.body: HIGH: V2 says the new A occupancy seam makes an already-required exact-zero fairness gate directly observable, but the unchanged queue-fairness contract still requires every variant to emit these fields as not_available, never zero, and says they are not gates. That directly contradicts the A overlay/evaluator contract (A emits integer zero; B/C/D remain not_available) and would make approved evidence violate this document. Amend this paragraph to require quiescent A slot/byte occupancy as exact integer zero after the measured cohort, retain not_available for B/C/D, and clarify it is the existing A leak gate rather than a cross-variant metric. The v2 scope paragraph must also acknowledge this evidence-surface clarification instead of claiming the only contract change is source binding.

data.reason: Protocol is internally contradictory: v2 claims A reservation-zero evidence, while the frozen fairness section still prohibits zero and requires not_available for A. Exact A/B source/hash binding is correct, and no other workload/gate/outcome drift was found, but this evidence contract must be reconciled before approval.

data.body: Addressed at exact 53af022. V2 scope now explicitly includes the evidence-availability clarification. The fairness contract separates non-gating detailed queue diagnostics (NA for all) from exact quiescent waiter_reservations_after/byte_reservations_after: A must emit integers and both must be zero; B/C/D remain not_available. New document SHA-256: e2c3f242f3b08ac5c904f9809eb8eb21114402efe18df4ac410331cc5a715961.

Verified at exact 53af022. The scope now accurately names both v2 changes, and the fairness section cleanly separates unavailable detailed queue diagnostics from the exact A-only quiescent occupancy evidence. A must emit integer zero for both fields; B/C/D remain not_available. This matches the source adapter and evaluator without changing the existing leak outcome.
